titleEnglish: Dağlar İle Taşlar İle — Let Me Call Upon You, My Lord
note: By Yunus Emre (13th c.). With all of creation — mountains, birds, prophets — the poet calls upon his Lord.

verses.ar:
Dağlar ile taşlar ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
Seherlerde kuşlar ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: With the mountains and the stones, let me call upon You, my Lord; with the birds at daybreak, let me call upon You, my Lord.

verses.ar:
Sular dibinde mâhi ile
Sahralarda âhu ile
Abdal olup yâhu ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: With the fish in the depths of the waters, with the gazelle upon the open plains, becoming a wandering dervish crying 'Yā Hū' — let me call upon You, my Lord.

verses.ar:
Gökyüzünde İsa ile
Tur dağında Musa ile
Elimdeki asâ ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: With Jesus in the heavens, with Moses on Mount Tur, with the staff in my hand — let me call upon You, my Lord.

verses.ar:
Derdi öküş Eyyub ile
Gözü yaşlı Yakub ile
Ol Muhammed mahbub ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: With sorely-afflicted Job, with tearful-eyed Jacob, with Muhammad the beloved — let me call upon You, my Lord.

verses.ar:
Hamd ü şükrullah ile
Vasf-ı Kulhüvallah ile
Dâima zikrullah ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: With praise and thanks to Allah, with the words 'Say: He is Allah,' always with the remembrance of Allah — let me call upon You, my Lord.

verses.ar:
Bilmişim dünya hâlini
Terk ettim kıyl ü kâlini
Baş açık ayak yalını
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: I have come to know the ways of this world; I have left its idle talk behind. Bare-headed and barefoot, let me call upon You, my Lord.

verses.ar:
Yunus okur diller ile
Ol kumru bülbüller ile
Hakk'ı seven kullar ile
Çağırayım Mevlâm seni
verses.en: Yunus recites with many tongues, with the doves and the nightingales, with the servants who love the Truth — let me call upon You, my Lord.
